raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its scientific reasoning regarding stellar sizes. It incorrectly stated that the largest main-sequence stars have radii of only "roughly 10 solar radii," whereas in reality, the largest main-sequence stars (such as R136a1) can have radii exceeding 300 solar radii. This significant underestimation of the size of the largest stars led the Planner to falsely conclude that the Sun would not appear "tiny" next to them, causing it to select the incorrect option (A) instead of the correct option (B).
